mission.title: Love Note
mission.description: Help the Merovingian get a message to the General, with Persephone as the bait.

npc.say: If you need anything, Flood will attend to it. Do not concern yourself about Persephone. She will do as she is told, and besides, the General will not harm her; he is much too intelligent to waste such an opportunity. At any rate, you will be there to protect her, non? You see, there is no danger.
Wait 'til I tell mother about this...
What gives him the right to command me? Ooh!
So this "General" bloke was causing trouble, eh?
Well, I'm sure he'll be on his best behavior now.
Pity we weren't there to cut his pretty soldiers down to size.
The fun thing about good little soldiers is that they're quite willing to die.
They are still flesh beneath those black suits...
Mmm... I suppose we had better be going...
Very good. You are not as incompetent as my husband says.
Do you think he can read?
Not the brightest-looking fellow, is he?

phase.briefing: It is becoming apparent that we must attract the General's attention in order to begin a discussion with him. The Merovingian has a certain plan to this end in which you will play a small part.

enter.say: I wonder if Flood's feeling okay. He didn't add his usual "And don't screw it up!"

talk.say:
Persephone!
Aha... Excusez... My wife is tired, and forgets what is important. We must get through to Monsieur le General.
We know that in the past he conducted surveillance on my wife, believing her to be a vulnerability in my defenses. We also know that his mysterious black-clad soldiers monitor certain computers within the city. Therefore, we will send Persephone to one of these computers, et voila, the contact will be made, n'est-ce pas?

If you need anything, Flood will attend to it. Do not concern yourself about Persephone. She will do as she is told, and besides, the General will not harm her; he is much too intelligent to waste such an opportunity. At any rate, you will be there to protect her, non? You see, there is no danger.

near.say: So this "General" bloke was causing trouble, eh?
Pity we weren't there to cut his pretty soldiers down to size.

phase.briefing: Persephone wants a little chat with you before the two of you go gallivanting off. Just make sure she follows the Merovingian's order.

enter.say: Aw, it looks like you won't quite be alone in there with her.

talk.say: I will not move a muscle simply because my husband snaps his fingers. But...I would not want to disappoint the General, since he has shown an interest in me. He is a curious man... I do not think he has ever been in love. A pity... There are many things he must not understand--even his own impulses. But such a man can be...useful.

done.say: Sounds like the plan is a go, then.

complete.say: Mmm... I suppose we had better be going...

phase.briefing: You're to meet Persephone at one of the deactivated terminals that the commandos have been using. The Merovingian thinks that the General's men will appear, but not attack. If that happens, you are to try to arrange a meeting with the General.

enter.say: That's the place. It looks like Persephone is already inside. Now remember, those new stealth-suit commandos don't show up on my screen, so keep your eyes peeled in there.

talk.say: About time you got here. Nothing-- Oh!

done.say: One of them showed up? He isn't attacking, is he? Okay... Persephone should have a letter for the General. Get it from her.
Take this, please. It is for that...thing.
Right. Now give the letter to the commando. Do you see a mail slot on him?
I will stay behind you, where it is safe. Give the letter to him.

objective.text: Give the letter to the Elite Commando

done.say: He took it? All right, I guess that's that. I wonder how often the General checks his mail?

complete.say: Very good. You are not as incompetent as my husband says.
Do you think he can read?
Not the brightest-looking fellow, is he?

phase.briefing: It appears that we've finally captured the old man's attention. Apparently he has some kind of reply ready. It could be a bomb, so we're sending you.

enter.say: Okay... I don't see any bombs in there, but there is an energy source of some kind.

talk.say:
This is the General. I received your message. I think I can get you what you want, and I may soon have a use for what you're offering. You'll hear from me again. In the mean time, my men will observe a cease-fire with your forces.
End transmission.

done.say: I'm transmitting that message to Flood right now.

near.say: Aha, a holographic projection. That must have his reply.

mission.finish: I'm not sure I like the General's cavalier attitude. So he means to keep us waiting? He'll do well not to test the limits of the Merovingian's patience.
